name: TimeCamp
summary: TimeCamp has a free plan for unlimited users, and its paid plans cost $3.99 to $9.99 per user a month on annual billing at its default prices, which change with the visitor's location. Timesheet approvals, screenshots and single sign-on are on Ultimate.

evidence.capability: time entry or clock in and out

facts.text: TimeCamp's pricing page adjusts prices to the visitor's location. We list the default prices published in the page.
Invoices made in TimeCamp can be exported to QuickBooks Online and Xero on Premium and above, and time entries can go to QuickBooks reports.
When the screenshots module is on, a screenshot is taken every 10 minutes, and an admin can turn the module off.
TimeCamp markets HIPAA-compliant time tracking. We found no mention of a business associate agreement.
The terms allow a refund requested within 3 days of a monthly billing period or within 30 days of payment for longer plans, while the pricing page FAQ says no refunds are granted.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Unlimited users and projects; no invoicing or approvals

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Billed annually; $5.49 on monthly billing. Adds invoicing and attendance

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Billed annually; $9.99 on monthly billing. Adds invoice export to QuickBooks and Xero and activity tracking

plans.name: Ultimate
plans.notes: Billed annually; $13.99 on monthly billing. Adds timesheet approvals, screenshots and single sign-on

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Price on request. Adds the time clock kiosk, geofencing and self-hosting

hiddenCosts: The AI time tracker is billed by token usage, which TimeCamp estimates at about $6 per user a month.
Visitors in some countries see different prices from the ones listed here.

contract.cancellation: Cancellation takes effect at the end of the billing period. The terms allow refunds within 3 days for monthly plans and within 30 days for longer plans.
contract.dataExport: Reports as Excel, PDF or CSV, or to Google Sheets, with PDF only on the free plan, plus an API on every plan.
